title: ICP-1.0 Intent: subscription.create
description: A buyer Agent's signed request to establish a recurring purchase authorization. See ICP-1.0 §6.5.

service_id.description: Merchant-defined service identifier (SKU, plan, tier). The merchant resolves this to a concrete service grant.

cadence.description: Billing period: a positive integer followed by a unit (s=seconds, m=minutes, h=hours, d=days, w=weeks, y=years). Common values: '1d','7d','30d','1y'.

max_total_per_period.description: Authoritative ceiling per occurrence. Merchant Quotes exceeding this MUST be rejected (ICP-1.0 §6.5, §11.4).

max_occurrences.description: If set, the subscription auto-terminates after this many occurrences. null = until cancelled.

first_charge_at.description: When the first occurrence triggers. SHOULD be >= iat; merchants MAY reject backdated start times.

principal_binding.description: The PrincipalBinding MUST grant `subscription.create` in its `authority.verbs` and SHOULD include a `max_per_period` matching or exceeding max_total_per_period.

metadata.description: Implementation-defined free-form fields. Verifiers MUST ignore unknown keys.
